about_the_game:
🎲 Real Dice, Real Luck!
Welcome to Farkle with Friends—a thrilling multiplayer dice game where physics-based rolling ensures that every outcome is truly random, not just computer-generated. Compete with friends online in fast-paced rounds where every roll could make or break your chances of victory.

🡆 Key Features:

  • Physics-Based Dice Rolls – No hidden RNG! Your dice roll is completely determined by physics, so every game is fair.

  • Multiplayer Fun – Play with friends in online matches.

  • Push Your Luck – Roll up to three times per turn, but be careful—if you can’t score, you lose all your points!

  • Unique Scoring System – Earn points through special combinations, like sequences, pairs, and high-value rolls.

  • Risk vs. Reward – Will you play it safe or go for a big gamble? The choice is yours!

  • Unlockable Dice Skins – Win games, complete challenges, and customize your dice with unique skins!

  • Custom Dice Rolls – Doubles, triples, and even full six-dice rolls come with their own twists!

  • Quick & Engaging Matches – Easy to learn, tough to master, and endlessly replayable.

No rigged numbers, no unfair algorithms—just pure skill, luck, and physics. Are you ready to roll?

  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard

  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
